title: Chapter 914
text:
Shattered Star Ring, Black Star Corps Headquarters, Second Satellite, No.001 Dome Training Ground.

This was a training ground that was much larger than the actual combat training room and could support a larger scale battle. It was built with high-strength alloy and could withstand even stronger attacks. The structure was similar to a circular stadium, and a gigantic circular mechanical dome covered the entire battlefield. The dome used a nano mimicry screen that could simulate the environment of the battlefield. There were transportation channels at the bottom of the training ground that were connected to the warehouse of the training mechanical soldiers.

Han Xiao sat on the high platform of the domed training ground and stared down with all his attention. Lagi, Feidin, Reynold, and the others were beside him, either sitting or standing, looking down at the battlefield.

At this moment, an intense battle was taking place in this dome training ground. There were a few openings on the ground, and a steady stream of training mechanical soldiers crawled out. There were Rangers, Mechanical Beasts, Hovering Cannons, and small Hovering Shield Shuttles. They all had different functions, and they charged at the two figures in the middle of the battlefield.

The standard of this battle was Grade D, and they were all low-grade mechanical soldiers. They used gunpowder and electromagnetic weapons, and the small caliber cannons fired continuously. The armor-piercing high-explosive bullets blasted the alloy ground of the training ground, creating a series of loud bangs.

Some of the mechanical soldiers were equipped with electromagnetic weapons, and they shot out tracers at high speed. The tracers were like light blue arcs of light, creating sparks on the ground and walls.

The two figures in the middle of the battlefield were a mechanical suit warrior covered in heavy black mechanical armor, and a mage covered in a runic magic shield. They were Nero and Tomar.

After learning from Reynold for a few years, Nero's Mechanical Force had reached Grade D, and apart from learning theory and assembly, Reynold had also arranged for him to undergo practical training.

Nero was still young, and his body was still in its infancy stage. However, because he had consumed the blood of the Astral Spirit Dragon and the life energy that Aurora had given him, his cells were extremely active, and his physique was not any weaker than an adult of the same grade. The strength of his Mechanical Force was also far above the average of his grade.

After two years of intensive learning, his [Intermediate Mechanical Sense] had evolved into [Advanced Mechanical Sense] under the effect of [Advanced Luck Glow]!

During the training, they were not allowed to use the weapons that Han Xiao had given them. Nero's armor and the turrets under his feet were all built by himself, and they were extremely powerful with the enhancement of his Mechanical Force. One by one, the mechanical soldiers were blasted into pieces by his cannon fire.

The reason why Han Xiao had come over was to test Nero's learning and see how this golden leek was growing.

Tomar was also a main character who possessed the Luck Aura. He had extraordinary talent in magic. Ordinary mages would take seven days to understand a spell model, but he was able to learn it in less than a day. His learning efficiency was astonishing. After learning from Lagi for so long, Tomar's growth was rapid. He was also a talent that Han Xiao had high hopes for.

Rumble!

In the field, the sound of gunfire was deafening. In the stands, Han Xiao touched his chin and said to Reynold, who was beside him.

"His mechanical ability is not bad, but his close combat skills are not that great. As soon as the mechanical beasts get close to him, he will be flustered. He still lacks experience."

"This is my negligence. I have been focusing on mechanical learning and neglected his close combat skills. In the future, I will increase his close combat skills," Reynold said with a serious tone.

"Increase the intensity," Han Xiao said with a heavy tone. "His mechanical learning cannot fall behind either."

"Understood."

Upon hearing this, Bennett's remote projection revealed a gratified smile.

Fu Ding could not stand it anymore and said helplessly, "The weakness of a Mechanic has always been close combat. Black Star, not every Mechanic is like you. Don't have such high expectations."

Han Xiao laughed and said, "As a person, one must have dreams. There's nothing wrong with having high expectations."

He was extremely happy in his heart. Nero's Mechanical Sense talent had already reached the Advanced level, and [Perfect Mechanical Sense] was just around the corner.

"Tomar's improvement is also great," Han Xiao added after thinking for a while and patted Lagi's shoulder. "You taught him well."

"But what's the use of that? One day, he …"

"Stop talking." Han Xiao's face darkened, and he covered Lagi's mouth with his hand.

Not long later, Nero's ammunition ran out, and Tomar's magic reached zero. The mechanical soldiers stopped at the same time, and the combat training ended.

The two of them were drenched in sweat and panted as they returned to the stands.

Han Xiao nodded with a smile and praised, "Not bad."

Bennett also had a look of relief on his face. "Your Excellency Black Star has taught you well. In a few more years, I probably won't be your opponent either."

Hearing the praise, Nero's face flushed red, and happiness was written all over his face.

Upon seeing this, Han Xiao nodded inwardly. He had high hopes for Nero. Not only did he want to obtain [Perfect Mechanical Sense], but he also hoped that Nero would become the backbone of the new generation of the army.

After a few more words of encouragement, everyone stepped onto the short-range spaceship and returned to the headquarters from the second satellite.

After two years of digestion, the Black Star Corps had already stabilized, and the Black Star Corps headquarters had added a few small mechanical satellite bases to accommodate more and more army members.

As soon as he returned to the headquarters, Sylvia came looking for him.

"Teacher, many partners are asking when the Black Star Party will be held this year."

Han Xiao raised his brows, thought for a while, and said, "In a few months. We can send out the invitations now."

The banquet that the Black Star Corps invited partners of the Evolution Cube to hold had already been held twice, and it was becoming more and more formal. Many organizations were looking forward to this opportunity to build a relationship with a higher civilization and called it the 'Black Star Party'. It formed a competitive relationship with Heber's' Tyrant Party '.

The Evolution Cube did not only bring about money, but it also allowed the Black Star Corps to be involved in many different industries. The army had a strong brand, and not many people in the Star Field could compete with the army.

The benefits of the Evolutionary Totem were like a catalyst, allowing the Black Star Corps to grow like a snowball. After two years of digestion, the Black Star Corps' industrial chain had been consolidated, and they already had the attributes of a financial group.

Due to the Evolutionary Totem, the Black Star Corps had more and more partners, and the influence of the Black Star Party had increased tremendously.

If the restrictions of the Evolutionary Totem were lifted, the benefits would multiply many times, but the pressure would also increase. Han Xiao was quite satisfied with the current situation. The pressure of the totem business had basically been transferred to the dynasty, and the army had avoided more than ninety percent of the risks.

"Okay, I'll go draft the invitation immediately … By the way, there's one more thing. There's a non-partner that wishes to participate in this Black Star Party."

"The Black Star Party only invites partners of the army, and the rest can be rejected. This is a rule that was set long ago. Why are you still asking me?"

"But this organization has a huge background, and it's not easy for me to make the decision. That's why I'm here to ask for your opinion."

Han Xiao raised his brows and was a little interested.

"Who's the other party?"

"The Limitless Financial Group."

Hearing this, Han Xiao's movements paused, and his eyes narrowed. His thoughts quickly turned.

Sorokin's Limitless Financial Group?

The two parties once had a hidden conflict. Sorokin had once sent his subsidiary organization to test the army players, but he was beaten up by Han Xiao. Now, more than two years had passed, and the other party suddenly wanted to participate in the Black Star Party. Who knew what their motive was?

"What's their reason?" Han Xiao pondered.

"The Limitless Financial Group wishes to cooperate with the army in terms of business, saying that it's related to the Flickering World. They know that after the first phase of the dynasty's development, they will divide the territory for their allies. This time, they want to discuss cooperation."

"I see, that makes sense …" Han Xiao understood.

Although the galactic financial group could not be the first to share the Flickering World's cake, they would definitely be involved in the subsequent construction.

The profits of the new Star Field were extremely high, so perhaps the Limitless Financial Group wanted to seize this opportunity?

However, although this reason was reasonable, because of the previous conflict, Han Xiao was still a little wary of the Limitless Financial Group.

He thought about it and said, "If that's the case, then send an invitation.

"Since that's the case, send them an invitation. Tell them that I wish to use this opportunity to meet Sorokin."

A few months later, the Pro League would be over, so Han Xiao was not afraid of the Limitless Financial Group causing any trouble.

A face-to-face meeting was also beneficial for knowing the enemy.

"Understood, I'll take care of it."

Sylvia nodded, turned around, and left the room.

Retracting his gaze, Han Xiao poured himself a glass of alcohol and dealt with the backlog of chores while drinking.

After a while, he took the time to open the forum.

Today was the day of the first round of the International Finals. The first round was between the first-ranked Rivervale and the Tomahawk Club. The number of viewers in the competition channel reached a new high.

With three Chinese teams entering the top eight, the players in the Shattered Star Ring were extremely excited. The way they saw it, if Dynasty, Long Sky, and Rivervale all won the first round, there would be three Chinese teams entering the top four. This was the greatest glory!

However, at the same time, a portion of the audience who did not have high hopes for the Chinese teams did not stop. With a rebellious mentality, they could not help but mock the Chinese teams, saying that all three teams would probably be defeated in the first round, and none of them would enter the top four.

In the final circle, all the teams would no longer hide their trump cards, and the competition would be even more intense. Han Xiao was also quite curious about what ranking the Chinese teams would obtain this time.
